# workspace-workflow-builder

> Skill for building workspace workflows from scratch or refactoring existing
> ones. Scaffolds project directory structure and AI agent workflow files
> (CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, GEMINI.md, MEMORY.md, .workflow-references/).
> Type C skill (YAML frontmatter + body).

## Key entry points

- SKILL.md: Skill definition (trigger patterns, compatibility, seven-phase procedure, Phase 0-6)

## Structure

- references/: Companion files loaded on demand during skill execution
- tests/: test_user_level_snippet.sh, the validation snippet's fixture suite; test_elicitation_consumers.sh, every question has a reader (both declared in CHECKS)
- scripts/: build-single-file.sh, which rebuilds dist/ from SKILL.md and references/
- dist/: Pre-built single-file distribution for environments without multi-file support
- README.md: Package overview and prompt design spec, with install steps
- LICENSE: MIT

## How it works

SKILL.md contains trigger patterns (build workspace, scaffold project,
set up AI agent files), compatibility requirements (git), and a
seven-phase procedure:

- Phase 0: Environment pre-check (sandbox detection, tool availability, risk tiers)
- Phase 1: Mode detection (bootstrap a new workspace vs. refactor an existing one vs. Mode C, only the user-level instruction files)
- Phase 2: Existing structure capture (refactor mode only)
- Phase 3: Requirements elicitation (preset, bilingual question bank: Track A A1-A6, Track B B0-B10, optional U1-U2; confirmation gate)
- Phase 4: Plan document generation (Category A project files, Category B agent files, Category C user-level instruction files only when U1 != A; user confirmation required)
- Phase 5: Execution (risk-tiered file creation, modification, deletion; sandbox degradation)
- Phase 6: Sync consistency enforcement (shared content kept identical across agent files)

## File manifest

| File | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| SKILL.md | Skill entry -- triggers, procedure, quality gates |
| references/environment-setup.md | Environment detection and setup procedures |
| references/elicitation-questions.md | Phase 3 bilingual question bank, Track A (A1-A6) |
| references/elicitation-track-b.md | Phase 3 bilingual question bank, Track B (B0-B10), including the B0 generation matrix |
| references/project-file-templates.md | Category A project file templates |
| references/agent-file-templates.md | Category B core: generation rules, block assembly, Method Y, Shared Step Fragments |
| references/entry-file-templates.md | Entry-file body written byte-identically to CLAUDE.md / AGENTS.md / GEMINI.md |
| references/memory-template.md | MEMORY.md template (four categories, Write Rules, Cleanup Policy) |
| references/change-logging-template.md | Change Logging Rule block, injected when A5 = C |
| references/phase-2-branch-templates.md | Index of the six PHASE 2 branch templates; routes A1 to one branch file |
| references/phase-2-branch-s.md | PHASE 2 template, Branch S (Engineering) |
| references/phase-2-branch-e.md | PHASE 2 template, Branch E (Data & Experiment) |
| references/phase-2-branch-p.md | PHASE 2 template, Branch P (Prompt & Agent Engineering) |
| references/phase-2-branch-d.md | PHASE 2 template, Branch D (Document & Research) |
| references/phase-2-branch-c.md | PHASE 2 template, Branch C (Content Operations) |
| references/phase-2-branch-o.md | PHASE 2 template, Branch O (Ops & Infrastructure) |
| references/git-workflow-template.md | GIT_WORKFLOW.md template (Solo + Team) |
| references/git-workflow-team.md | GIT_WORKFLOW.md template, Part C: Team mode |
| references/visual-presentation.md | Visual presentation rules, only when deliverables include visual output |
| references/execution-steps.md | Phase 5 execution procedures and the execution summary |
| references/print-output.md | Press-file rules, only when a deliverable is a PDF for a print shop |
| references/user-level-files.md | Home-folder instruction files (U1-U2; Claude, Codex, Gemini, Other) and Mode C (Home only): managed personal-defaults block, Home-tier write, resolution and validation snippets |
| CHECKS | Checks run by check-artifact.sh A11, one command per line |
| tests/test_user_level_snippet.sh | Runs the shipped validation snippet on 16 fixtures in a temp dir, must-fail cases included |
| tests/test_elicitation_consumers.sh | Fails on any question in the two question banks that no other reference file reads; 4 must-fail fixtures |
| scripts/build-single-file.sh | Rebuilds the single-file distribution (one appendix per reference module) |
| dist/SKILL_workspace_workflow_builder_single.md | Single-file distribution build |
